text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] Post-deploy streaming error surge - route=inference-edge-us-west - symptom=streaming 504s and stalled SSE connections - PagerDuty PD123456 fired to SRE rotation

pagerduty-bot: PD123456 -> triggered, assigning to alex (primary). Incident bridge: https://zoom.us/j/00000000000 (pd:PD123456)

alex: acked. I'm oncall and joining the bridge. pulling up the dashboards now. any immediate customer reports?

anya: CS queue has ~8 noisy threads, one escalated to priority. customers affected appear to be long-streaming sessions (tokens > 2k).

alex: ok looking at metrics: p50 latency normal, p95/p99 for /v1/stream spiking to 4-6s and many 504s. error budget bump at 34m.

alex: running quick tail of canary logs for batcher pods:
```
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-batcher-canary -c batcher --since=10m | grep -E "timeout|kv-cache|stall|504" | tail -n 40
```

maria: I see repeated `KVCacheMiss` and `async-kernel-timeout` entries on the new quantized kernel. repro on canary nodes. difference compared to stable: kernel v2.0.7 -> v2.1.0.

jonah: traffic is currently 10% to canary. recommend immediate diversion to stable and rollback canary image. I'll start the diversion.

jonah: running routing change:
```
redwoodctl traffic shift --from inference-edge-us-west --to inference-edge-us-west-stable --percent 100 --reason "canary 504 spike"
```

incident-bot: traffic-shift job started (job id ts-9876). Notifying load-balancer and edge proxies.

alex: seeing request volume drop on canary pods and 504s per minute dropping. p95 trending down after ~45s.

maria: initiating canary rollback to image inference/batcher:2.0.7
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-batcher-canary batcher=inference/batcher:2.0.7 --record
```

maria: rollback rollout status: waiting for new pods to be Ready.

sre-oncall: synthetic checks running from edge regions:
```
# before rollback: curl -s -D - http://edge-us-west/api/v1/stream -o /dev/null
# returned: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
# after rollback (probe): HTTP/1.1 200 OK (streaming starts)
```

alex: good signs. error rate down to ~baseline in last 2 minutes. holding for stabilization window 5m.

anya: opening customer-impact assessment: initial estimate ~18 unique customers saw at least one degraded streaming session. majority recovered after traffic shift. filing CS ticket CS-1342 and adding impacted customer list.

maria: cross-checking logs: root trigger appears to be a regression in kernel memory handling for long sequences that causes KV cache stalls and eventual request timeouts under continuous-batching. will include kernel diff in RCA.

jonah: PD incident PD123456 -> escalated to SRE lead for visibility. PD status: acknowledged by alex at 3432109880.

pagerduty-bot: PD123456 acknowledged by alex. Escalation to oncall-lead scheduled at +10m if not resolved.

alex: current mitigation: traffic fully diverted to stable, canary rolled back. Observability: p99 latency back to baseline, 5xx count at normal. I propose we close the immediate page once stabilization window passes and open a follow-up RCA.

maria: agreed. I'll own the RCA. collecting kernel traces, coredumps, and batcher telemetry. plan to post a timeline and root cause doc in the next 24h.

anya: CS notified, affected customers contacted with status and ETA for RCA. minimal business impact flagged: some interactive sessions truncated; no data loss reported.

alex: handing off monitoring and follow-ups to maria for RCA and to jonah for infra changes (we should add canary memory safety checks). I'll sign off from incident bridge in 10m. anyone else pick up?

maria: taking over. I'll keep watch and update the thread. creating postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/PD123456-rca-draft

incident-bot: PD123456 -> status: mitigated; awaiting confirmation to resolve.

jonah: will add an automated synthetic for long-sequence SSE streams to detect regressions earlier. PR to follow: #2345.

pagerduty-bot: PD123456 -> resolved by alex at 3432109940.

alex: closing loop: confirmed stability across edge regions for 10m. closing page. follow-up actions: (1) RCA w/ kernel diff + mitigation (maria) (2) infra guardrail for canary traffic thresholds (jonah) (3) CS follow-up and customer notes (anya).

maria: acknowledged. scheduling postmortem review with SRE + Runtime team tomorrow 10:00am PT.

anya: noted. I'll coordinate customer comms after RCA.

sre-oncall: leaving final note: PD123456 -> Incident resolved. Postmortem and action items tracked in the doc above.

alex: thanks team. handing to next rotation. :white_check_mark:
